Strategy: Bins leaving at least 50 residual after placement are preferred, emptier among them, while bins leaving less use Best Fit, so the rule protects large reusable residuals when possible. It differs from Best Fit whenever a large-leftover bin exists. It may help by keeping genuinely useful bins open for future large items, or fail by leaving many half-empty bins behind.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [((r - item) if r - item >= 50 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
